items.title: Surjectivity of flat pullback on Chow groups for a morphism whose restriction to a neighbourhood of every point is a product with affine space
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma says that pullback along a flat morphism of relative dimension r which is locally a product with A^r over the base is surjective on Chow groups in every degree (statement lines 5650-5660, tag 02TT). The proof is a genuine induction on two parameters: on the dimension of the base, using the product structure over a dense open together with the exact sequence of an open immersion, and then on the number r of A^1 factors, where the remaining case is that of a dominant integral hypersurface whose generic fibre is cut out by a monic irreducible polynomial, giving rational triviality after shrinking the base. Both reductions require the reader to track cycles through open immersions and infinite sums, so the claim is H2.
